name: elagoht/health
description: Package health answers liveness and readiness probes for a collage application, turns readiness false while the server drains, and can shed load past a cap on requests in flight.

config.description: Package health answers liveness and readiness probes for a collage application, turns readiness false while the server drains, and can shed load past a cap on requests in flight.

cacheFor.description: how long one readiness result is reused, default "1s"

details.description: a JSON body naming each check, default false

maxInFlight.description: requests served at once at most, default 0: no cap
